BIG ART ENERGY

THE POWER TO TRANSFORM YOUR SPACE.

THE BIGGEST SIZES ONLINE

THE BIGGEST WALL ART, ANYWHERE

BIG Wall Decor is the largest online store for affordable, oversized wall art and decor. We work with this generation’s favorite artists to bring you high quality pieces that are larger than life.

THIS IS BIG ART ENERGY

BIG Art Energy is the power of art to transform a room and the people in it. It’s what happens when a bold, oversized art fills your walls with confidence and emotion instead of emptiness. Because when your walls feel alive, you do too.

BEST SELLING LARGE WALL ART

LARGE WALL ART. MADE EASY.

Owning oversized art used to be expensive, complicated, and permanent. We fixed all that. BIG Wall Decor turns ordinary walls into statements.

THREE WAYS TO HANG ART

Whether it’s Artfab swappable prints & Infinity frame, Museum Grade Infused Acrylic, or renter friendly Stickablez peel and stick canvas, you’ve got 3 easy ways to hang oversized art made to fit real life.

NEW LARGE WALL ART

CUSTOMIZE YOUR OWN ART

Don’t let your photos stay hidden on your phone. Instead turn them into a captivating collage that you can enjoy.

SIZE MATTERS: GET MORE FOR YOUR MONEY

At BIG Wall Decor, we understand that when it comes to wall art, size matters. That’s why we’re proud to offer the largest sizes for the best value in the industry. We believe that everyone deserves to make a statement with their art, regardless of budget constraints. Unlike traditional galleries where large-scale pieces come with extravagant price tags, we’ve made it our mission to break down barriers and make high-quality art accessible to all.

REAL ARTISTS. REAL STORIES. REAL BIG.

We now collaborate with over 90 independent artists — each with their own bold perspective. When you buy BIG, you support the people who make your walls worth looking at. The artist also gets a share of the sale, so you are directly contributing to them with your purchase. We exist for the artists who dare to dream large and for the collectors who crave something authentic.

WHO IS BIG WALL DECOR?

We make large-scale, artist-designed wall art that’s bold, affordable, and built for real life (not art snobs). Our pieces aren’t just big — they’re designed to transform your space, becoming the focal point of any room. With thousands of artworks from global creators, simple returns, and flexible formats, BIG Wall Decor is your one-stop shop for oversized art that fits your style and your life.

We believe art should be accessible, not intimidating. That’s why every piece is easy to hang, easy to change, and easy to love.
No art degrees. No gatekeepers. Just walls that look alive.

This is Big Art Energy — the force that makes your space feel bigger, bolder, and undeniably you.
